_comment: Index-specific option expiry dates. Populated annually. Used by expiry_selector (DTE-optimal selection) and expiry_guardian (index-specific pre-entry DTE check — a Monday-afternoon position is 3-DTE for one index but 4-DTE for another, so a generic 'next expiry' is WRONG).
_VERIFY_BEFORE_ENABLE: These dates are WEEKDAY-GENERATED placeholders (NIFTY=Thu, BANKNIFTY=Wed, FINNIFTY=Tue per spec) and are NOT holiday-adjusted. NSE has revised index expiry weekdays/cadence repeatedly. The operator MUST replace this with the official NSE circular dates (holiday-adjusted) before setting options_trading.enabled = true. Boot validation only checks presence/structure, not correctness of the specific dates.
